target_description: Reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 78%

notes: ALS LIMITED has committed to Net Zero by 2050 with Scope 1 & 2 emissions reduced by 95% and Scope 3 by 90% against 2020 baseline. Near-term 2030 target is 78% reduction in Scope 1 & 2. Baseline year: 2020. By March 2023, company had already achieved 58% reduction and carbon neutrality for Scope 1 & 2, exceeding initial 40% by 2030 goal. Scope 3 inventory calculated in FY2023; formal 2030 target to be set within two years.

target_scope: Scope 1 (direct landfill methane emissions) and Scope 2 (electricity and facility operations). Methane comprises ~80% of emissions from landfill sites; CO2 from fleet combustion and energy use.
sbti_notes: Targets are internally set and aligned with a 1.5°C Paris Agreement trajectory. Cleanaway states targets are "consistent with a 1.5 degree trajectory" but targets have NOT been formally validated by SBTi (Science Based Targets Initiative). Company is a signatory to the Global Methane Pledge (30% methane reduction by 2030).

notes: Comprehensive search of public sources found no published emissions reduction targets, net zero commitments, or climate goals for Grosvenor Engineering Group Pty Ltd (the Australian building services company). target_description: Portfolio temperature rating reduction: Scope 1+2 from 3.2°C (2021 baseline) to 2.3°C by 2027; Scope 1+2+3 from 3.2°C to 2.5°C by 2027. Additionally, reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 (market-based) GHG emissions 50% by 2030 from 2021 base year.

sbti_notes: Metrics Credit Partners (fund manager) is working toward verification of SBTi targets. Company commits to set long-term science-based target to reach net-zero value chain GHG emissions by no later than 2050 in line with SBTi Net-Zero Standard. Signatory to Net Zero Asset Managers (NZAM) initiative. Near-term targets (2030 operational; 2027 portfolio) aligned with SBTi Financial Sector Guidance at 1.5°C ambition for operations and 1.5°C/2°C for portfolio.
notes: The targets are corporate-level commitments from Metrics Credit Partners (the fund manager), not specific unique targets for the MRE fund itself. Confidence is "medium" because while the targets are verified through NZAM signatory status and official company ESG pages, they apply to the fund manager rather than the fund as a distinct entity. For fund-specific climate disclosures, investors should consult the Product Disclosure Statement (PDS) and ASX announcements.

target_description: Scope 1 & 2: 50% reduction by 2030 (baseline 2021); Scope 3: 25% reduction by 2030 (baseline 2020, covering 1 of 15 categories)
sbti_notes: No SBTi validation found for NIB Holdings Limited. (Note: Nordic Investment Bank is a different organization with SBTi-validated targets.)
notes: NIB Holdings Limited (ASX:NHF) is an Australian health insurance company. Company has achieved a 93% reduction in Scope 1 & 2 emissions by FY22 (baseline FY21), already exceeding its 2030 target. However, Scope 3 value chain emissions increased 90% from 2020 baseline to 2025, placing the company off track on that metric. The company is certified carbon neutral through Climate Active and reports annually through TCFD framework and Carbon Disclosure Project. Targets are internally set and disclosed in sustainability reports, not third-party validated by SBTi.

target_scope: Measured emissions include: electricity, business travel, capital goods, employee commute, purchased goods and services, waste. Scope 1, 2, 3 breakdown not explicitly defined.

target_description: METRICS INCOME OPPORTUNITIES TRUST does not have separate climate targets as it is a managed fund. Climate targets disclosed are attributable to the investment manager, Metrics Credit Partners Pty Ltd. Metrics Credit Partners has committed to: (1) reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 (market-based) GHG emissions 50% by 2030 from 2021 base year (operational emissions); (2) reduce portfolio temperature score from 3.2°C (2021) to 2.3°C by 2027 for Scope 1+2 (financed emissions); (3) achieve net-zero value chain GHG emissions by no later than 2050.
sbti_notes: Metrics Credit Partners (the investment manager) made Initial Target Disclosure to SBTi in November 2022 via Net Zero Asset Managers initiative. NOT YET verified by SBTi. Company committed to seeking SBTi validation within 24 months following publication of SBTi Financial Institutions Net-Zero Standard.
notes: METRICS INCOME OPPORTUNITIES TRUST (ASX:MOT) is a listed managed investment trust focusing on private credit. The trust itself does not set separate climate targets. The targets disclosed apply to Metrics Credit Partners Pty Ltd, the investment manager. Metrics measures financed emissions across 97.5% of portfolio by value. Confidence is "medium" because while targets are clearly stated by the manager and disclosed via NZAM, they are not yet SBTi-verified and apply at the manager level rather than the fund level specifically.
